programs.title: A Plane Crash Recreated
programs.desc: The authors of the series analyze the most famous plane crashes.There will be witnesses' accounts, discussions of records from black boxes and reenactments of dramatic events in a modern flight simulator.

programs.title: Life Below Zero: First Alaskans
programs.desc: A story about the indigenous people of Alaska who have lived according to the rhythm of nature for centuries.Each season has its own rules here.Tig Strassburg wants to give seven children the knowledge and skills to survive in this hostile place.Young Apassingoks hunt for the entire local community.Joel Jacko combines tradition with modernity.Jody Potts-Joseph, on the other hand, begins a new chapter of life in her home village.Marvin Agnot survives on what he catches in the ocean or finds on the coast.John and Teresa Pingayak are also training the next generation.

programs.title: Border Patrol
programs.desc: Employees of the Customs Service and the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry form a patrol guarding New Zealand's borders.The threat to the country is the smuggling of drugs, weapons and other illegal materials.

programs.title: Air Crash Investigation 21
programs.desc: Reconstructions of real plane crashes.By recreating the course of events, the program's creators try to understand what led to the unfortunate events.They recreate the circumstances in which the tragedy occurred: the weather, the atmosphere on board the plane, the decisions and actions of the pilots.They also show the work of people investigating the causes of disasters and conduct a computer flight simulation.Viewers can hear various comments from specialists and testimonies of witnesses to these events.The creators of the program will prove that air accidents are often caused by human slowness and lack of imagination.Each disaster is thoroughly analyzed and the lessons learned help minimize the number of tragedies in the future.

programs.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report 5
programs.desc: Analysis of the most tragic air accidents.The investigation is based on detailed reconstruction of events, photographic materials, accounts of survivors and rescuers, and computer graphics.

programs.title: Drain the Oceans 3
programs.desc: The sea depths hide many secrets.Scientists can unravel further mysteries thanks to groundbreaking research and modern technologies.Viewers can expect exciting expeditions to the underwater world.

programs.title: UFOs: Investigating the Unknown
programs.desc: New information about UFOs reinforces the need for explanations.Governments are being urged to be more transparent.The need to increase the participation of independent scientists and citizens in research is also emphasized.

programs.title: Lost Cities Revealed with Albert Lin
programs.desc: Albert Lin explores ancient cities and learns the secrets of ancient builders.The respected scientist completed, among others:a search expedition for Genghis Khan's tomb in Mongolia.The researcher once again sets out on an extraordinary mission.Viewers will be able to watch him wander through the jungle, trying to find objects related to the Mayan settlement.As always, it is equipped with modern devices that allow you to scan the surroundings.The National Geographic envoy is not afraid of risk.He will break through untouched areas, cross wild rivers and slide down a rope into a giant cave.He will undertake all these daring feats to solve another mystery from the past.

programs.title: Primal Survivor: Extreme African Safari
programs.desc: Master survivalist Hazen Audel will undertake a demanding expedition through the Great Rift Valley, the largest continental rift in the world, which is considered a mecca for wildlife.It is also home to many nomadic tribes.The presenter does not hide the fact that completing the 800-kilometer route is one of his dreams.The traveler will set off during the animal migration season, which will allow him to admire animals living in the savannah up close.The six-episode series will present, among other things, an encounter with majestic elephants.Viewers will also have the opportunity to observe a million-strong flock of flamingos.The escapade would not have been possible without the help of local East Africans.Their invaluable tips allow you to move relatively safely in a land full of steep slopes.
